summary: Unlock the potential of sustainable business practices with our specialized training. Equip yourself with the knowledge to drive environmental policy forward.
lede: Sustainable business and environmental policy training helps practitioners turn sustainability goals into operational plans. It is for sustainability, environmental, compliance, public-sector, utility, NGO and operations professionals who need to manage environmental performance and demonstrate progress. Participants learn to interpret policy requirements, prioritize environmental and ESG risks, build governance and supplier controls, choose actionable KPIs, and prepare audit evidence and clear performance reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for corporate, public sector, and NGO professionals responsible for embedding sustainable practices into policy, operations, and reporting.
audience: Public sector staff in environment, climate, energy
modules: Foundations of Sustainable Business and Environmental Policy
Understanding Environmental Policy, Law, and Regulatory Expectations
Building a Practical Sustainability Governance System
Materiality and ESG Risk Identification for Real Decisions
Sustainable Procurement and Supplier Environmental Controls
Designing Sustainability KPIs, Dashboards, and Evidence Trails
Environmental Incident Prevention and Response Planning
Compliance Audits, Inspections, and Performance Assurance
Sustainability Reporting and Communication That Builds Trust
Designing a Sustainability Action Plan That Can Be Implemented
Integrating Sustainability Into Strategy, Projects, and Daily Decisions
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of environmental and sustainability concepts and be in roles related to compliance, operations, or strategy implementation.
